moments.desc: Catherine halts the wedding and declares, 'Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh... I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.' She commands, 'Bring her in.'
Juliana is marched in chains through the cathedral. Catherine watches with gloating satisfaction and taunts, 'There she is.' The congregation sneers and whispers mockingly.
Juliana stands defiantly in the aisle and retorts, 'You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?' Catherine murmurs coldly, 'Still arrogant. Still standing.'
A massive explosion shatters the cathedral entrance. Silhouetted armed figures emerge from the smoke and rubble. Juliana turns to look at them, her expression shifting to awe and hope.
